behaviors.description: Use per-app storage and persist a private-home path across build invocations.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent build app/runtime, isolated host home, and seeded per-app data.
behaviors.expected: with-appdir redirects XDG data to the documented app directory with real reads/writes; persist retains bytes across invocations without writing into the ordinary host home.

behaviors.description: Enforce build network grants and revocations through a host TCP listener.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent build app/runtime and a controlled loopback listener.
behaviors.expected: Sharing reaches the listener, a later unshare denies connection, and a later share restores access.

behaviors.description: Enforce build shared-memory device grants and revocations.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent build app/runtime and a unique host shared-memory marker.
behaviors.expected: The host marker is unreadable without shm access, readable after a grant, and unreadable after revocation.

behaviors.description: Enforce build SSH socket exposure and revocation.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent build app/runtime and a case-local Unix socket supplied as SSH_AUTH_SOCK.
behaviors.expected: The exposed socket path exists with the grant, disappears after revocation, and reappears after a later grant.

behaviors.description: Merge build generic policy additions and removals into public sandbox metadata.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent build app with a preexisting generic policy value.
behaviors.expected: Both added values replace the removed value in effective /.flatpak-info policy.

behaviors.description: Observe both build verbosity modes around quiet payload executions.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent A build payload and installed runtime.
behaviors.expected: Diagnostic invocations add stderr lines while quiet controls remain stable and all invocations print A.

mappings.rationale: Independent host markers and cross-launch reads distinguish per-app storage and private-home persistence from ordinary build storage.

surface_assertions.rationale: The sandbox selects the real per-app XDG data directory and reads/writes its controlled files.
A private-home marker survives another build only when persistence is granted, without appearing at its host-home path.

mappings.rationale: Real connections to a host-only listener distinguish granted and private network namespaces.

surface_assertions.rationale: Network sharing permits a connection to the controlled host listener.
Revoking sharing blocks that same host connection after a grant.

mappings.rationale: Host marker reads distinguish shared and private /dev/shm.

surface_assertions.rationale: The shm device grant exposes exact independent marker bytes.
Revocation hides the host marker even after an earlier grant.

mappings.rationale: A real controlled socket path is exposed or hidden inside the build sandbox.

surface_assertions.rationale: The socket grant exposes the SSH endpoint named by its sandbox environment.
A later revocation removes access to that endpoint.

mappings.rationale: Generic policies are public metadata; exact effective values distinguish additions and removal.

surface_assertions.rationale: Both added policy values appear in effective sandbox metadata.
The previously present policy value disappears from effective metadata.

mappings.rationale: Quiet/flagged/quiet runs preserve payload output and demonstrate additional diagnostics.

surface_assertions.rationale: Verbose build adds stderr lines without changing probe output.
OSTree verbosity adds stderr lines without changing probe output.
